[Saba, the young man relates, in my yeshiva they went to a wedding in Yerushalayim

And the entire way, the young man relates, they put on the tape “Na Nach Nachma Nachman MeUman..”

Also inside the wedding, in the middle of the music, they put on the cassette]

[“Na Na Nach Nachma..”]

[..There was great joy, the young man relates that he was in the yeshiva.., at the wedding, the “Na Na Nach” makes a great commotion]

[Saba and the friends continue to sing: “Na Nach Nachma Nachman MeUman..”]

[There was another wedding in Haifa, they went to a wedding in Haifa, the entire way on the bus they put on a “Na Na Nach” cassette

So the young men of my yeshiva, the entire way in the direction of Haifa, sang the entire way

All the young men in the yeshiva, some hundred young men, on the way, on the bus sang “Na Na Nach”, and also at the wedding]

[Saba and the friends continue to sing: “Na Nach Nachma Nachman MeUman..”]

[Saba, do you want we should call television? Eh, they will come photograph you.. “Na Na Nach Nachma Nachman MeUman..”]
